Dino Dash

Jump the cactus. Beat the desert.

Dino Dash, made in Code Studio

How to play

How to play

Goal: Help the dino run as far as you can without touching a cactus.

  • Green flag: start the game
  • Space bar: jump

You win when your score reaches 30.

You lose when the dino touches a cactus.

Screenshots

Ready to run: click the green flag.

Timing is everything: jump right before the cactus.

So close! Game over at 23 points.

Why it's fun

One-button play

All you need is the space bar, so anyone can start playing in seconds.

It gets faster

The cacti speed up as your score goes up, so every run feels harder.

Beat your best score

Every run is a new chance to get closer to 30.

How I made it

  • A loop: a forever loop moves the cactus to the left and sends it back to the right side of the screen.
  • An if/then: if the dino is touching the cactus, the game says "Game over" and stops all.
  • A variable: score goes up by 1 every second, and the game speeds up when it gets bigger.
  • A bug I fixed: the dino kept falling through the ground, so I added a block that sets its y position back to the ground after each jump.
  • What I learned: testing my game again and again helps me find bugs fast.
